name: bhagyarekha
description: BhagyaRekha / ഭാഗ്യരേഖ — independent Kerala lottery results and historical statistics (workspace root)

scripts.dev: pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' run build && pnpm -r --parallel --filter @bhagyarekha/api --filter @bhagyarekha/web run dev
scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' run build && pnpm -r --filter './apps/**' run build
scripts.typecheck:build: pnpm --filter @bhagyarekha/api run build && pnpm --filter @bhagyarekha/web exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false --incremental false
